title: Iris Production — Full ML Pipeline with SHAP + ONNX + FastAPI

modules.dataset: Iris loader (sklearn or CSV) + stratified train/test split + FeatureSchema
modules.model: Pipeline builder (ColumnTransformer+StandardScaler→classifier) for LogReg/RF/SVM/LightGBM; SHAP hook; ONNX export via skl2onnx
modules.train: argparse CLI: trains all 4 candidates, picks best by accuracy, exports to ONNX

entry_point: python train.py [--models logreg random_forest svm lightgbm] --out models/best.onnx
